race.comment: HES A TERROR (5) finished second at his last run just three days ago over 1740m at this track, beaten 3 metres. Meets a comparable field and he can get the job done. IM HARVEY SPECTER NZ (4) settled back off the wide starting position on the front line last start and failed to run on when seventh over 1740m at this track. Finds a suitable assignment and from this favourable draw can play a major role. TIGER CHEDDAR (8) is the next elect off a last-start win by 3.5 metres at this track over 1740m. GLAMOUR FOX (2) is the best of the rest after finishing fourth over 1740m at this track last time out.
